publication.body:
## Summary

- land the accepted Phase 29 mounted-page Newly provenance and source-aware Undo scope across ordinary Explorer cards and Explorer Search results
- archive the completed Phase 29 product scope and the completed, revised Phase 28/29 workflow audit
- disclose Advisory P29-01: fresh-output manual smoke found the ordinary Explorer-card gap and broader eight-theme prototype-fidelity debt; explicitly defer a read-only owner/path/task audit to Phase 31 after Task 163 and before Task 164, with no repair authority

## Validation

- pnpm test - 99 files / 1,196 tests passed at pre-close and in the replacement detached preview
- pnpm lint - 0 errors / 11 unchanged warnings
- pnpm typecheck
- pnpm build - seven routes generated
- git diff --check, Gate C artifact-pin validation, and exact-main merge-tree passed
- task owner tests cover only their declared DOM/state/interaction invariants; no Phase 29 browser visual-fidelity comparison is claimed
